character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Aldric at 16, young squire guard of the town, the grown-up version of a boy who wore a red scarf. Messy chestnut-brown hair, green eyes, confident friendly grin. Wears light chainmail under a red tabard with a simple white emblem, the old red scarf around his neck, leather gloves, brown pants, leather boots, a sword sheathed at his left hip. Empty hands relaxed at his sides, holding nothing. Same chibi anime pixel art style as the reference: big head, black single-color outline, cel shading, low top-down view.
